Title: Istoria del Concilio di Trento, scritta dal padre Sforza Pallavicino della Compagnia di Gesù, ora Cardinale della Santa Romana Chiesa, ove insieme rifiutasi con autorevoli testimonianze un'istoria falsa divolgata nello stesso argomento sotto nome di Pietro Soave Polano; nuovamente ritoccata dall'autore e divisa in tre volumi: PARTE PRIMA
Creator: Sforza Pallavicino (1607-1667)
Publisher: In Roma: per Biagio Diversin e Felice Cesaretti, librari all'Insegna della Regina, MDCLXIV (1664), the author's revised edition in three parts; the first edition appeared in 1656-1657
Publication Date: 1664
Rights: Public Domain (published 1664; public domain by date)
Language: ita
Source: Internet Archive item bub_gb_iVsda5kt9jIC (Google scan; contributor National Central Library of Rome), file bub_gb_iVsda5kt9jIC_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the library/source-research thread (Era VII session), 2026-10-16; host rights statement: licenseurl http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/ (Public Domain Mark 1.0).
Provenance note: Header prepended; the OCR text follows unchanged, no long-s characters present (0 replaced; the OCR renders long s as f, as in "fopra"). Rights basis in one checkable sentence: the title page in the OCR reads "IN ROMA, MDCLXIV", so the volume was published in 1664, long before the 1930 cutoff of the project's rolling 95-year rule.
Content note: PARTE PRIMA of the three-part 1664 edition, Libri I-VIII (the file opens with Libro Quarto in its OCR headings and carries the earlier books before them). Pallavicino's history was written to answer Sarpi's Istoria (the English Sarpi is vendored as sarpi_history-of-the-council-of-trent_brent1676.txt); it is a pro-Curia narrative by a Jesuit who became a cardinal, written about eighty years after the events and drawing on papal archives, so it is a later interpretive history and not a Council record. OCR quality: clean Italian print, sampled at five points and readable at each, long s rendered as f. Whole-file share of word-shaped tokens: 0.72. No English translation of Pallavicino's history exists in the Internet Archive (search of 2026-10-16), so there is no English beside this Italian.
